title: Would like / Would like to / Would like (Obj) to

lessons.title: Would like + Noun
lessons.content: Use 'would like + noun' to express a desire for something. 'Would like' is a polite way to say 'want'.

details.example: I would like a cup of tea.
details.burmese: ကျွန်တော်တို့ လက်ဖက်ရည်သောက်ချင်ပါတယ်။

details.example: I wouldn't like a cup of tea.
details.burmese: ကျွန်တော်တို့ လက်ဖက်ရည် မသောက်ချင်ဘူး။
မင်း ဆန်းဒျ်စ်လိုချင်လား။

lessons.title: Would like to + V1
lessons.content: Use 'would like to + V1' (base form) to express a desire to do something.

details.example: I would like to drink coffee.
They wouldn't like to stay here.
details.burmese: သူတို့ ဒီမှာ မနေချင်ကြဘူး။

details.example: Would you like to see an action movie tomorrow tonight?
details.burmese: မင်း မနက်ဖန်ညမှာ action movie ကြည့်ချင်လား။

lessons.title: Would like (Obj) to + V1
lessons.content: Use 'would like + object + to + V1' to express a desire for someone else to do something.

details.example: I would like you to work hard.
details.burmese: ကိုယ် မင်းကို အလုပ်ကြိုးစားစေချင်တယ်။

details.example: We wouldn't like her to leave.
details.burmese: ငါတို့ သူမကို မသွားစေချင်ဘူး။

details.form: Would you like + obj + to + V1?
details.example: Would you like me to come with you?
details.burmese: မင်း ကိုယ့်ကို မင်းနဲ့အတူလိုက်စေချင်လား။
